sources.excerpt: Keeley Electronics Filaments High Gain Distortion - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Keeley Electronics Filaments High Gain Distortion Posted By Pedal of the Day on Friday, January 26, 2018 in Keeley Electronics, Overdrive / Distortion | 0 comments --> --> Although we’re not the fastest or most technical of players around here, we sure can appreciate a good heavy metal tune, and the pedal we’re going to look at today is capable of providing the tones needed for speed, thrash, glam, black, death and other metal genres with ease. Robert and the kids at Keeley Electronics have covered just about all the bases when it comes to effects, and the Filaments High Gain Distortion is just another wicked rad box in their portfolio. Emulating high-gain tube amps and boasting an abundance of opportunities to yield crushing, ear-exploding tones, this is one aggressive and potent stompbox . Presenting you with 3 layered stages of gain and 7 different ways to EQ you tone, the Filaments is not light on tonal enhancement. Level and Gain do their jobs, respectively, both with a fat spectrum to play with and delve into. The Presence knob and the Bright toggle switch work in conjunction to provide a boost to any pickup configuration you may have, making all your guitars stand out, regardless of electronic layout. The two other toggles, Boost and Crunch, provide two differing gain and compression tones, making it fun to mix and match to find what works best for your amp and setup. The EQ section is where you can really dial this bad boy in. Bass and Treble adjust your low and high end frequencies, as expected, but there’s more for you to work with here. The Body knob fine-tunes more lows, giving you a fat and beefy but not muddied sound, and using the Treble knob right after it, your amp will project crisp metal lead runs, big, bold, sustained chords and even some tasty feedback if you want to toss that in as well. You can even run it at 18V for more headroom and louder production if that sort of thing gets your creative juices a-flowing. With the typical Keeley tough build and legendary quality, the Filaments Distortion is not a pedal you have to worry about breaking down, and is a road-worthy piece of your musical pie. Certainly not for everyone (no clean boost found here, people), the players in the genres it was designed for will really, really dig it, and should become a staple for heavy metal rigs for years to come. Your Email Keeley Electronics, the leading manufacturer of pedals built in the U.S., announces the release of our most potent and aggressive metal stompbox to date: the Filaments High Gain Distortion Pedal. The Filaments accurately replicates high-gain tube amps by layering 3 stages of gain while providing 7 ultra-flexible ways to EQ the tone. The Filaments has more flexibility in tone-shaping than any other Keeley stompbox. Level and Gain set the stage for rich layers of high gain tube-amp saturation. Bass and Body give you the punch and authority of a gain monster no matter what size amp you are playing. Even if you’re running a 10-inch speaker the bass and body controls will give you the low end bass response you need. Running through a 4×12 already? Just dial back the body control to keep the sound tight and focused. Have an amp that’s hard to push? The Boost and Crunch switches give you two different levels of gain and compression to get your edge just right for your tone. The Presence control works with the Bright control to give any guitar or pickup combination the authority to stand up and shout. Lastly, the Treble control gives you that added range of highs to make your amp sing.
